what: The literal lane-identity rule (rank rho >0.90 OR forward 3-px dot overlap >0.70 vs ANY registry raster) is unsatisfiable in two edge cases: (a) space-filling family lattice rasters whose 3-px halo covers 99.87% of the footprint make every possible dot set a 'duplicate'; (b) continuous score surfaces of any two competent fault detectors on this stack are naturally rho ~0.90 because faults are where they are (this session: 0.9013 with zero shared columns).
